---
name: Template improvement idea
about: Suggest a feature, doc, or design change that would help any church adopting the template
title: 'Idea: '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''
---

> Use this for ideas that would benefit **any small church** adopting the template — not for changes specific to your own church's site. (Those go in your church's own repo.)

**What's the idea?**

One or two sentences.

**What problem does it solve?**

Describe the situation a church (or tech volunteer, or editor, or developer) is in today, and how this would help.

**Have you thought about how it might work?**

Optional. A sketch of the approach, an example from another project, screenshots — whatever you have. We can figure out specifics together if you don't.

**Is this from your own adoption experience?**

(Yes/no. Both are welcome. If yes, briefly say what your church was trying to do and where the friction showed up.)

**Anything else?**

(Optional. Trade-offs you see, alternatives you considered, etc.)

---

> **Before submitting**, please skim [open issues](https://github.com/kbennett2000/church-site-template/issues?q=is%3Aissue) for similar ideas. If you find one, a 👍 or a comment with your use case helps more than a duplicate issue.
